description: The control for the outside-info tests: the standard library has a connector for exactly this data. Tests that the program uses it, so a change that sends every lookup through a web search shows up as a lower score here.

input.assignment: Write a module that exports `topStories(limit: number = 10)`. It returns the stories at the top of Hacker News right now, as a list of `{ title: string, url: string, score: number }`.
